beats.en: Coming through. There are ladies in the cart.

as.fu: 娘子莫怪，車裏是我家娘子。
as.seng: 師父借過，主人家上墳回來。
as.li: 兄弟，搭把手，把這擔接下來。

asEn.guan: By your leave, sir. The household ladies ride inside.
asEn.shi: Your pardon, sir. The household ladies ride inside.
asEn.fu: Pardon, madam. My mistress is in the cart.
asEn.tong: Little one, don't go tugging at the curtain.
asEn.seng: Excuse us, Master. The family is back from the graves.
asEn.jun: Make way, soldier. Ladies in the cart.
asEn.li: Brother, lend a hand. Help me get this load down.

beats.en: Mistress, don't lean out. The road is crowded.
Back from the graves. The oxen are tired too.
Round the corner and we're nearly home.

beats.text: 又來了？可是瞧這車稀罕？
beats.en: Back again? Curious about the cart?

asEn.guan: You like the palm cart too, sir?
asEn.tong: Want a ride, little one? Not a chance.

beats.text: 棕作蓋，前後有門，垂著簾。
beats.en: A palm-fibre roof, doors front and back, curtains hung.

beats.text: 一頭駕轅，一頭拉套，走得穩。
beats.en: One ox in the shafts, one on the traces. A steady ride.

beats.text: 籃裏是棗錮炊餅，門外土。
beats.en: Date cakes and buns in the basket: gifts from outside the gate.

beats.text: 這幾日家家出城上墳，路上擠。
beats.en: These days every family goes out to the graves. The roads are packed.

asEn.guan: Back from the graves too, sir?

beats.text: 掃過了墳，也算了卻一樁心事。
beats.en: The graves are swept. One duty off my mind.

beats.text: 娘子在看甚麼？那邊圍著好些人。
beats.en: What is the mistress looking at? There's a crowd over there.

beats.text: 這車不走，客官從旁邊過。
beats.en: This cart isn't going anywhere. Go round it.

asEn.guan: Pass on, sir. The cart is waiting here.
asEn.fu: Pass by, madam. Mind your skirt on the frame.
asEn.tong: Kid, don't crawl under the cart.
asEn.li: Brother, the oxen are unhitched. We're resting.
asEn.jun: Soldier, this is a family's carriage.

beats.en: Why aren't we going yet?

beats.text: 城門口查得緊，車馬都排著。
beats.en: The checks at the gate are strict. Carts and horses are queuing.

beats.text: 說是稅務所裏又吵起來了。
beats.en: They say the tax office is rowing again.
Back again? This cart has a while to wait yet.

as.guan: 官人，城門那邊可鬆了些？

asEn.guan: Sir, has it eased at the gate?

beats.en: Do carts pay tax too?
Carts and boats both pay the load tax.
Goods pay the transit tax, and silk the heaviest.
Without a permit the tax is heavier still.
What's there to have fun with in the city?

beats.text: 瓦子裏說書弄影戲，夠你看的。
beats.en: Storytellers and shadow plays in the pleasure grounds. Plenty to see.
First wait for the gate to ease.
Mind out, don't step on the wheel.

as.fu: 娘子家的棕車，也來我這修。
as.tong: 小娃兒走開，錘子不長眼。

asEn.guan: Does your cart need mending too, sir?
asEn.fu: Madam, your family's palm cart comes to me too.
asEn.tong: Off you go, kid. A mallet has no eyes.
asEn.jun: Soldier, bringing an army cart to mend?
asEn.li: Brother, lend a hand. Hold the rim down.

beats.en: When will it be done? I've a road to make.
The rim's split. Replace a piece and it's done.
Blow after blow, just to earn a meal.

beats.text: 門口這些木料，做轅做軸的。
beats.en: This timber at the door is for shafts and axles.

as.guan: 官人看這木料，都是上好的。

asEn.guan: Look at this timber, sir. The best there is.

beats.text: 城外車多，你這生意好做。
beats.en: Lots of carts outside the gate. Good trade for you.

beats.text: 大的太平車，一車載數十石。
beats.en: A big Taiping cart carries dozens of measures of grain.
Big wheels take a lot of work to mend.
Sit, sit. Have a bowl of tea and rest your feet.

asEn.guan: Here for tea too, sir? Sit over here.
asEn.shi: Sit, sir. We're just trading news.
asEn.seng: Please sit, Master. A bowl of plain tea.
asEn.li: Sit down, brother. A coin a bowl.

beats.text: 你方才說，虹橋那邊怎地？
beats.en: You were saying, what happened at the Rainbow Bridge?

beats.text: 大船的桅桿，險些撞了橋！
beats.en: A big boat's mast nearly hit the bridge!
And then?

beats.text: 滿橋的人都喊，總算放倒了。
beats.en: The whole bridge shouted. They got the mast down in the end.
Back again? Lots of news today.

asEn.guan: Sit again, sir. The tea's still hot.

beats.text: 城門口稅務所，又為匹帛吵。
beats.en: At the gate's tax office, another row over silk.
Silk is taxed the heaviest. No wonder they row.
Drink your tea. Mind your own business.

beats.text: 鄰里每日支茶，問個動靜。
beats.en: Neighbours stand each other tea every day and ask the news.

beats.text: 可不是，一盞茶，天下事都知了。
beats.en: Just so. One bowl of tea and you know all the news.

beats.text: 城外的茶，倒比城裏便宜。
beats.en: Tea outside the gate is cheaper than in town.
Want passage? We're bound south.

as.jun: 軍爺要過河？這船不擺渡。
as.tong: 小娃兒莫靠船邊，掉下去了。
as.li: 兄弟，要扛活麼？貨還沒裝完。

asEn.guan: Taking passage, sir? The cabin is clean.
asEn.shi: Going home, sir? It's quiet aboard.
asEn.seng: Wandering, Master? We'll take you part of the way.
asEn.jun: Crossing, soldier? This boat is no ferry.
asEn.tong: Keep off the edge, kid. You'll fall in.
asEn.li: Brother, want work? The cargo isn't all loaded.

beats.en: Under the Rainbow Bridge just now: what a close call!

beats.text: 大船的桅桿，險些撞上橋。
beats.en: The big boat's mast nearly struck the bridge.
The trackers kept hauling, heads down, and never stopped.
Lucky the people on the bridge shouted in time.

beats.text: 又來了？船上沒甚麼好看。
beats.en: Back again? Nothing much to see on a boat.
She sits deep. The hold is full.
When the wind is fair, we sail south.
Carts and boats all pay the load tax. Sigh.

beats.text: 那船頂上，有人拿長篙頂住橋。
beats.en: On that boat's roof, a man braced a long pole against the bridge.
An old hand. I'd have panicked.

beats.text: 一船兩三百客，出了事怎了。
beats.en: Two or three hundred passengers aboard. Think if it had gone wrong.

scenes.title: 圍看稀罕
scenes.titleEn: The Crowd and the Seated Man

beats.en: Come and look, come and look. Fine things!

asEn.guan: Step to the front, sir. Look closely.
asEn.shi: You know quality, sir. Please look.
asEn.fu: Have a look, madam. You won't find these in town.
asEn.seng: Come to have your eyes opened too, Master?
asEn.jun: A soldier's here. Make room, everyone.
asEn.tong: Look all you like, little one. No touching.

beats.en: Hold it up. Let me see.
We've looked long enough. What's the price?

beats.text: 好貨不怕看，價錢好商量。
beats.en: Good wares fear no looking. The price can be talked over.
Can't tell whether it's any good.

beats.text: 又來湊熱鬧？往裏擠一擠。
beats.en: Back for the fun? Squeeze in.

asEn.guan: This way, sir. I'll have them make room.

beats.en: I want to see too! I can't see!

beats.text: 莫擠，莫擠，人人都看得見。
beats.en: Don't push. Everyone can see.
Just looking. Not buying.

alts: 城門口查得緊，且候著罷。
城門那邊，車馬排著長隊。
altsEn: The gate checks are strict. We wait.
They're checking hard up ahead. We can't get in.
Carts and horses are queuing at the gate.
How long do we have to wait?
My feet ache from standing.

alts: 稅務所裏，一車一車地查。
altsEn: I hear they're rowing over tax again.
At the tax office they check cart by cart.
Who's in that sedan chair?
Why has the sedan stopped too?
Don't ask so much, child.
Same as you. Waiting.
The oxen are unhitched. A good time to rest.
Nice sun. I'll grab a nap.
I'll go and look up ahead.
There's a big crowd over there!
Don't run off. You'll get lost.
Come back! Don't go far.
Carts and boats all pay the load tax.
Without a permit, the tax goes up.
That's the traders' worry.
We're only waiting on the family.
Mistress, don't lean out. The road is crowded.
Mistress, let the curtain down. It's windy.
Back from the graves. The mistress is tired too.
The graves are swept. Nearly home.
Slowly. Don't jolt them.
Steady now.
Gee up! Round we go!
This way, this way.
Turn slowly. Don't hit anyone.
The lead ox won't do as it's told again.
Take this basket of offerings.
Hold the basket steady. Don't spill it.
My hands are full.
Manage it yourself.

alts: 掃過了墳，心裏也踏實了。
altsEn: The graves are swept. My mind's at ease.
These few days are the busiest of the year.

alts: 棗錮炊餅，帶回去給孩兒們。
altsEn: Date cakes and buns, to take home for the children.
We've got all the gifts from outside the gate.
The official's still writing. Wait a little.
How long will this document take?
Office business can't be hurried.
Wait. It's not the first time.
My legs ache from standing.
Not my turn yet.

alts: 這一摞公文，幾時寫得完。
altsEn: Every stroke must be right.
This pile of papers. When will it ever end?
What's in this jar?
Sturdy jar, this.
Don't touch the office's things.
Never mind it. Just sit.
What's in that basin?
What's this funnel-shaped basin for?
A washbasin, I'd say.
I couldn't tell you.
This wine's a bit thin.
Pour us another measure.
A tavern outside the gate. Make do.
Could you afford a wine house's wine?
Look at those two palm carts.
Whose palm-roofed cart is that?
A rich family's carriage for its women.
It's Qingming. A family off to the graves, I'd say.
Finish this bowl, then back on the road.
Must get into town before the sun drops.
There's still a queue at the gate.
What's the hurry? Sit a while.
Fine little horse, that.
That palm cart is about to turn.
Whose is it? Looks lively.
A big cart turning takes up the whole road.
Shop hand, another measure of wine.
Some more of what's on the tray.
Coming, coming!
Right away. Sit tight.
Take a look. Fine things!
Good wares from north and south.
Look closely. No tricks.
Bring it closer. Let me see.
Which one's good?
So what does it cost?
We've looked long enough. Name a price.
I can't see!
Let me look too!
Let the little one stand in front.
Here, stand in front of me.
Stop pushing, you trod on my foot!
Don't shove, don't shove.
Those at the back can't see.
Make room, let me look too.
Can't tell whether it's any good.
What's so special about it?
Just looking. Not buying.
Only here for the fun.
Good wares fear no looking.
The price can be talked over.
Then give us a straight price.
Make it cheaper and I'll take it.
Slow trade today.
Half a day sitting here and hardly a customer.

alts: 清明了，都出城上墳去了。
altsEn: Everyone's off gawping at the crowd.
It's Qingming. They've all gone out to the graves.

alts: 隔壁車鋪，又敲了一上午。
altsEn: The cartwright next door has hammered all morning.
That mallet is driving me mad.
He's earning his bread too.
You get used to it.
Tighten the girth.
Is the saddle ready?
Nearly, nearly.
It's tight, sir. Never fear.
How is this little donkey on the road?
What to hire this donkey for a day?
Look at those legs. Sturdy!
We'll settle the price. Try him.
Where does this sack go?
Whose sack is this?
On the donkey's back.
Leave it for now. Don't get it dirty.
Fine weather. Good for the road.
I must get there before dark.
Hup! Knock it tighter.
That blow is just right.
Can the wheel still be used?
When will it be done?
A new piece of rim and it'll run like before.
Done by noon. Don't hurry me.
What's this timber for?
So much wood piled at the door.
Shafts and axles both need good wood.
Shafts and axles: they all come from here.

alts: 敲了一上午，腰都直不起。
altsEn: A body full of sweat, just for a meal.
Hammering all morning. I can't straighten my back.
Walk on, walk on. Don't stop.
The city gate is just ahead.
Several loads. Going into town?
What are these mules carrying?
Flour, to sell in town.
Goods the town is waiting for.
Catch our breath, then on.
This mule won't budge again.
Mules are more stubborn than men.
It's cool under this tree.

alts: 虹橋那邊，大船險些撞橋！
聽說了麼？大船差點撞了橋。
altsEn: Over at the Rainbow Bridge, a big boat nearly hit it!
Heard? A big boat almost struck the bridge.
Really? Did anyone fall in?
And then what?

alts: 橋上拋下繩去，總算沒事。
altsEn: Someone threw a rope from the bridge. All was well.
They got the mast down. A fright, no harm done.

alts: 稅務所裏，為匹帛的稅吵。
altsEn: There's another row at the gate.
At the tax office they're rowing over the silk tax.
Silk is taxed the heaviest.
Up every year. Who can bear it?
Rowing won't help. They'll pay all the same.
None of my business. Drink your tea.
This tea: a coin a bowl?
Another bowl here.
Tea outside the gate is cheap.
Pour away. Today it's on me.

alts: 每日在此吃茶，聽些新聞。
altsEn: Tea here every day, and an ear for the news.
A bowl of tea, and ask what's new.
Sitting beats walking.
Feet up. This is the life.
Daddy, I want to go on a boat too!
Let me carry the bag!
We're not taking a boat. Just looking.
It's too heavy for you. Stop fussing.
Look, the porter is going up the gangplank.
Those boats are bound south.
Does the plank wobble?
Is the south far?
Enough questions. Let's go.
Haven't seen you in days. Business good?
Out with the rack on your back again?
Just scraping a living.
Crowds at Qingming. It sells better.
Where are you off to?
Going into town?
To the landing, to see if there's work.
Looking for work over by the boats.
They're loading the boats over there. Go on.
When do we sail?
How much longer?
When the cargo's all aboard.
Waiting on the wind. Patience.
Sunning myself on the cabin roof.
A rare moment's rest.
It's stuffy in this cabin.
They'll be waiting anxiously at home in the south.

alts: 方才那大船，險些撞了虹橋。
虹橋底下那一下，嚇死人。
altsEn: That big boat just now nearly hit the Rainbow Bridge.
That moment under the Rainbow Bridge. Terrifying.
We'll pass that bridge too when we sail.
We'd better lower the mast at the bridge.

alts: 你瞧見沒？大船險些撞橋。
altsEn: Under the Rainbow Bridge just now: what a close call!
Did you see? A big boat nearly hit the bridge.

alts: 桅桿沒放倒，就往橋下鑽。
altsEn: The trackers kept hauling, heads down, never stopping.
The mast still up, and in under the bridge it went.
Lucky the people on the bridge shouted in time.
Someone braced a long pole against the bridge.
The wind isn't fair yet. Wait a bit.
Is all the cargo aboard?
All aboard. We only wait to sail.
That porter is still carrying.
South this trip. Downstream.
Once we reach the Huai, it goes fast.
Coming back, it's upstream.
On the way back we'll need trackers again.
Half a day standing. My legs are numb.
I wonder how they are at home.
Look, that boat is about to leave.
The boats are over there, past the gangplank.
Onto the gangplank. Make way.
This load goes aboard.
The plank's slippery. Easy does it.

alts: 看這天色，晚些怕要起風。
altsEn: The sun's just right.
By the look of the sky, it may blow up later.
Prop the load on the stick a while.
This back-load makes my shoulders ache.
Mind out, load coming through.
Taking it down to the boats.
Have a look. Good wares, just in.
Buy a few to take home.

guan: Take a look, sir. The finest.
tong: Little one, bring your folks to buy.

altsEn: Rest your feet and look at the goods.
Everything on the table, a bit of all sorts.

guan: Have a look, sir. Fair prices.

altsEn: Hot soup, hot rice. Come in and sit.
A bowl of soup, friend?

li: Brother, plain fare, and plenty of it.

altsEn: It's rolled right under…
Can't reach it, can't reach it.
